open_points.subject: A17
open_points.text: Registry opens each listener for itself alone, never with an option that lets another socket bind the same endpoint.
open_points.question: What must a Required tests item show to prove that each live listener prevents another socket from binding the same endpoint?
options: An integration test attempts a concurrent second bind and requires it to fail.
A factory gate verifies the listener's socket options.
Remove this invariant and rely only on the different-port check.
open_points.default_guess: Add an integration test that opens each Registry listener, attempts a concurrent bind to the same endpoint, and requires that bind to fail.

open_points.subject: A21

open_points.question: Which security-review categories were reopened by A17's new imported port bounds, different-port refusal, exclusive listener binding, check precedence and diagnostic, and what is each category's reviewed outcome?
options: Re-perform the affected categories and record that their outcomes remain unchanged.
Re-perform the affected categories and change one or more outcomes or references.
State explicitly that none of the new A17 rules changes the subject of any category, with the category-by-category basis.
open_points.default_guess: Re-perform authentication_credential_abuse and concurrency, record the new listener-isolation and startup-refusal rules considered, and retain their existing APPLICABLE outcomes if the review finds no further change.
